title: AstralBeam theme definition
description: A compact theme definition. The runtime derives reasonable light defaults and a complete dark theme from optional dark background, foreground, primary, and accent values, then validates opaque CSS colors and semantic contrast.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor validation and completion.

themeColor.description: An opaque CSS <color> value. CSS parsing, opacity, derived-color generation, and semantic contrast are validated at runtime.

colors.description: Theme colors. Light semantic roles are authorable; dark background, foreground, primary, and accent values are optional, and all remaining dark roles are derived.

background.description: Page background. Defaults to shadcn's neutral white light surface.

foreground.description: Default page text. Defaults to shadcn's neutral near-black foreground.

card.description: Card surface. Defaults to a neutral white surface.

card-foreground.description: Card text. Defaults to an accessible value derived from foreground.

popover-foreground.description: Popover text. Defaults to an accessible value derived from card text.

primary.description: Required organization brand color used to derive primary accents and dark roles.

destructive.description: Destructive status color. Defaults to shadcn's red status color and is contrast-corrected when necessary.

warning.description: Warning status color. Defaults to an amber status color and is contrast-corrected when necessary.

ring.description: Focus indicator color. Defaults to an accessible value derived from primary.

chart-1.description: First categorical chart color. Defaults to primary.

chart-2.description: Second categorical chart color. Defaults to an sRGB-gamut-mapped shadcn neutral color.

chart-3.description: Third categorical chart color. Defaults to an sRGB-gamut-mapped shadcn neutral color.

chart-4.description: Fourth categorical chart color. Defaults to an sRGB-gamut-mapped shadcn neutral color.

chart-5.description: Fifth categorical chart color. Defaults to an sRGB-gamut-mapped shadcn neutral color.

sidebar-primary-foreground.description: Sidebar primary text. Defaults to an accessible value derived from the card surface.

lightColors.description: Light-mode semantic colors. Primary is the only required seed; every other role is optional and derived when omitted.

radius.description: A nonnegative px, rem, em, or percentage length. Unitless zero is also accepted.

darkColors.description: Optional dark-mode values. Background, foreground, primary, and accent can be authored; every other dark role is derived.
